qualifier: glucuronate-to-xylulose 5-phosphate route
name: Glucuronate-xylulose pathway of pentose metabolism
rationale: All members concern conversion of glucuronate through pentoses to xylulose 5-phosphate (including essential pentosuria), distinguishing it from the galactose, fructose/alditol and non-oxidative pentose phosphate neighbours.

core: Sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium release in muscle
qualifier: with cytosolic calcium clearance and contraction restraint
name: Muscle sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium release and cytosolic clearance
rationale: Members regulate ryanodine-receptor calcium release, SR calcium uptake and Na/Ca exchange in cardiac and skeletal muscle, with emphasis on lowering cytosolic calcium, relaxation and negative regulation of heart rate/contraction rather than the force-increasing terms of the neighbours.

qualifier: incretin (GLP-1, GIP) stimulation and insulin processing
name: Incretin-stimulated insulin processing and secretion in beta cells
rationale: Members cover GLP-1/GIP synthesis and action, proinsulin processing and glucose-stimulated insulin secretion in beta cells, unlike neighbours centred on KATP channels, fatty-acid/acetylcholine modulation, GLUT4 or pancreatic development.

qualifier: downstream branched-chain amino acid catabolism and biotin-dependent carboxylases
name: Downstream branched-chain amino acid catabolism and biotin-dependent organic acidurias
rationale: Members are mitochondrial acyl-CoA steps of leucine, isoleucine and valine breakdown, their organic acidurias and biotin/carboxylase defects, distinct from the BCKDH/MSUD, fatty acid oxidation and lipoylation neighbours.

qualifier: trophoblast giant cells and decidualization
name: Peri-implantation lineage specification, trophoblast giant cells and decidualization
rationale: Members cover the earliest embryonic lineage decisions (inner cell mass, trophectoderm, primordial germ cells) and implantation-stage trophoblast giant cell endoreduplication and decidualization, unlike neighbours focused on germ-line maintenance or labyrinthine placenta development.

core: Cell cycle exit to quiescence during differentiation
qualifier: retinoic acid-induced
name: Quiescence entry and exit with retinoic acid-induced differentiation
rationale: Members regulate G1-G0 and G0-G1 transitions linked to differentiation together with retinoic acid receptor signalling and RA-induced repression, distinct from the p53/p21 arrest and thyroid/nuclear receptor neighbours.

qualifier: Pol I termination and 5S rRNA
name: Ribosomal RNA transcription termination and 5S rRNA synthesis
rationale: Members concern termination of RNA polymerase I rRNA transcription and Pol III transcription of 5S rRNA, whereas neighbours cover Pol I initiation/promoter regulation or Pol III tRNA/snRNA transcription.

qualifier: mesangial, endothelial and basement membrane components
name: Glomerular mesangial, endothelial and basement membrane development and filtration
rationale: All members concern glomerulus formation and filtration function via mesangium, endothelium, basement membrane and vasculature, distinguishing it from podocyte/nephrin and tubule or kidney-growth neighbours.

qualifier: initiation: preinitiation complex, promoter opening and escape
name: RNA polymerase I transcription initiation and promoter escape
rationale: All three members are the initiation steps of Pol I rRNA transcription (PIC assembly, promoter opening, promoter escape), whereas neighbours cover Pol I elongation/termination, rRNA processing or Pol III transcription.

core: DNA base damage repair and demethylation
qualifier: direct alkylation reversal and post-incision base excision steps
name: Alkylation damage reversal, base excision gap-filling and DNA demethylation
rationale: Members cover direct reversal of alkylation (ALKBH2/3, MGMT), AP-site resolution and gap-filling in base excision repair, and TET/TDG-mediated 5-methylcytosine demethylation, lacking the glycosylase recognition/cleavage and OGG1/MUTYH steps of the neighbours.

qualifier: UV and oxidative stress with SASP
name: UV and oxidative stress-induced premature senescence and SASP
rationale: Members describe UV and oxidative stress responses leading to growth arrest, premature senescence and the senescence-associated secretory phenotype, unlike neighbours centred on oncogene-induced senescence, Polycomb silencing or p53 apoptosis control.

qualifier: collagen degradation and metalloproteinase activation
name: Extracellular matrix remodelling via collagen degradation and metalloproteinases
rationale: Members are ECM gene modules plus MMP activation and collagen catabolism, contrasting with neighbours focused on integrin/fibronectin adhesion, stromal mechanosignalling or collagen/elastic fibre synthesis.

core: Chromosome condensation and sister chromatid cohesion
qualifier: cohesion establishment and CENP-A centromeric chromatin assembly
name: Chromosome condensation, cohesion establishment and CENP-A centromere assembly
rationale: Members cover mitotic/meiotic chromosome condensation, cohesin loading and cohesion establishment, and CENP-A nucleosome deposition, while neighbours concern cohesion resolution, nucleosome assembly or nuclear envelope dynamics.

qualifier: transcription and mtDNA maintenance
name: Mitochondrial transcription and mtDNA maintenance
rationale: Members are mitochondrial transcription initiation, termination and regulation together with mtDNA metabolism and repair, distinct from neighbours on mitochondrial translation, RNA processing/stability or mtDNA replication.

qualifier: proliferation, cytokine output and regulatory T cell differentiation
name: T cell proliferation, cytokine and Treg differentiation control
rationale: Members predominantly restrain T cell activation, proliferation and cytokine (IL-2, IFN-gamma, IL-6, IL-10, IL-21) production and regulate Treg/Th17 differentiation, unlike neighbours on innate cytokine/TLR suppression, tolerance induction or NK cytotoxicity.

qualifier: from lipid and growth factor receptors
name: Protein kinase C signalling from lipid and growth factor receptors
rationale: Members converge on PKC activity (phorbol ester response, PKC regulation, PRKCZ) triggered by LPA/sphingolipid receptors, VEGFR2 and estrogen, whereas neighbours centre on G-protein calcium/IP3, cAMP or BCR signalling.

qualifier: FSH/LH secretion and Sertoli cell-driven seminiferous tubule growth
name: Gonadotropin secretion and Sertoli cell-driven seminiferous tubule development
rationale: Members link positive FSH/LH secretion and FSH response with Sertoli cell proliferation and seminiferous tubule development, whereas neighbours concern Leydig/germ cells, ovarian follicles or activin signalling.

core: Viral attachment and entry into host cells
qualifier: receptor binding, endocytosis and membrane fusion
name: Viral attachment, entry and host cell membrane fusion
rationale: Members centre on virus-receptor attachment, endocytic entry and fusion across dengue, RSV, influenza, HIV and coronaviruses, lacking the viral protein maturation/assembly and host restriction terms that define the neighbours.

qualifier: methylation of rRNA and tRNA
name: Ribosomal and transfer RNA methylation
rationale: Members are rRNA 2'-O and base methylation, tRNA and guanine-N7 methylation and related rRNA/tRNA metabolism regulation, while neighbours centre on rRNA cleavage, pseudouridylation, aminoacylation or mitochondrial RNA modification.

qualifier: of PC, PE and PI
name: Phosphatidylcholine, ethanolamine and inositol acyl-chain remodelling
rationale: All members are Lands-cycle acyl-chain remodelling of PC, PE and PI, unlike neighbours covering PG/PS remodelling or PA, DAG/TAG and PC de novo synthesis and hydrolysis.

qualifier: downstream of receptor tyrosine autophosphorylation, receptor-nonspecific
name: PI3K-AKT activation downstream of receptor tyrosine autophosphorylation
rationale: Members are generic PI3K/AKT (and ERK) activation following tyrosine autophosphorylation, including its constitutive cancer form, without the insulin/IGF1R, ALK/LTK or MET receptor-specific steps of the neighbours.

qualifier: dentin, enamel and cementum mineralization
name: Tooth development and dental hard tissue mineralization
rationale: Members cover odontogenesis, odontoblast differentiation, tooth eruption and mineralization of dentin, enamel and cementum (with restraint of bone mineralization), distinct from bone mineralization/phosphate neighbours and ectodermal appendage development.

qualifier: by reduced cell-matrix adhesion, spreading and Rho/Rac signalling
name: Epithelial migration control via reduced cell-matrix adhesion and spreading
rationale: Members regulate epithelial/keratinocyte migration mostly by inhibiting spreading, lamellipodia, integrin and Rho/Rac signalling and promoting adhesion disassembly, unlike neighbours promoting CDC42/actin protrusion or VEGFR2/junction regulation.

qualifier: sterols, quinones and vitamin K-dependent gamma-carboxylation
name: Mevalonate-derived sterols, quinones and vitamin K-dependent carboxylation
rationale: Members span isoprenoid and cholesterol biosynthesis, ubiquinone/menaquinone metabolism and vitamin K-dependent gamma-carboxylation, whereas neighbours add vitamin E, bile acid synthesis or cytochrome P450 disease terms.

qualifier: target genes and NRF2 regulation/degradation
name: NRF2 target gene transcription and NRF2 turnover
rationale: Every member is NFE2L2-regulated transcription of antioxidant, metabolic, ER-stress and inflammatory genes or regulation of NFE2L2 itself, unlike neighbours on ROS detoxification, FOXO/UPR stress responses or p53 metabolism.
